record.note: THE CUT OPENED ON A SCREEN RECORDING AND NOBODY SAID WHAT IT WAS OF. First notice of loss, intake and clause all arrive inside the first fifteen seconds of the old opening, and none of them was explained, so a judge who has never filed a motor claim had nothing to hold on to. This beat is twelve seconds because that is what the cap left after the eight recorded beats, not because twelve is the right length for an introduction. The colours are the page's own dark palette from assets/styles.css: a slide that introduces the product in colours the product does not use reads as a different product.
